title: Ridgeline Special Order Services Paid-in-Full Programs: Damage Allowance Amount
content:
**Determination.** The damage allowance on a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program paid in full at order is the program's damage allowance percentage of the delivered price, rounded to the nearest cent. The delivered price is the order total billed plus every home delivery fee billed on the order.

## Terms used

- **The order total billed** is the amount of the order billing line on the order.
- **Every home delivery fee billed** means every home delivery fee line on the order's ledger, added together; an order with no home delivery fee line adds nothing.
- **The program's damage allowance percentage** is the figure of the order's program in the Ridgeline Special Order Services damage report and allowance table.
- **Rounding.** The allowance is figured as the delivered price multiplied by the percentage divided by 100, and that figure is rounded to the nearest cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical program percentage of 10)

| Order total billed | Home delivery fee lines | Delivered price | Allowance |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2400.00 | one line of 79.00 | 2479.00 | 247.90 |
| 2400.00 | none (store pickup) | 2400.00 | 240.00 |
| 615.40 | one line of 79.00 | 694.40 | 69.44 |

## Basis questions

**Is the delivery fee part of the price the allowance is figured on?** Yes. Every home delivery fee billed on the order is added to the order total billed to give the delivered price.

**What does a program percentage of 0 give?** An allowance of 0.00.
